R/ GEN AVG FELIC COS VI

A Roman silver coin: a denarius of Commodus as augustus, dating from AD190 - 191 (Reece period 9). The reverse legend reads: GEN AVG FELIC COS VI. The reverse type depicts Genius standing, facing left, sacrificing from a patera over an altar and holding a cornucopia. Rome mint. Reference: RIC volume 3, number 227.
